Package com.bupt.ta.model

Class ApplicantProfile

java.lang.Object
com.bupt.ta.model.ApplicantProfile
public class ApplicantProfile extends Object
Applicant profile for TA recruitment: personal data, education, courses, availability, skills, and CV reference.

Persisted in WEB-INF/data/profiles.json (one row per user) via ProfileService. Public fields support direct JSON serialization. Legacy field names (degreeProgramme, yearOfStudy, etc.) remain for backward compatibility with older profile records.

Not thread-safe; concurrent edits to the same profile should go through the service layer.
